offers_products.reason: Builds and sells new single-family homes to buyers across several states.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from home sales; mortgage affiliate KBHS and design studio are ancillary to the homes.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Homebuyers and families choose and purchase personalized new homes.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells homes to individual households, not businesses or government.

recurring_revenue.reason: Each home is a one-time purchase by a buyer.

cyclical_demand.reason: New home purchases are easily postponed when the economy weakens or rates rise.

big_ticket.reason: A home is the largest, rarest purchase for a household.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for built homes, a physical product, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual households buying homes.

asset_heavy.reason: Homebuilder needs land and inventory, but uses subcontractors and no plants or fleets; mostly working capital.

notes: Asset-heavy is a judgment call because land inventory is large.
